name: Transactional Side-Effect Ledger
mechanism: Assigns runtime-generated causal operation identities and records authorization, intent, commit and reconciliation state around non-idempotent external effects.
use_when: Retries or resume can repeat irreversible effects
External sinks support idempotency or reconciliation
avoid_when: No authoritative commit or reconciliation signal exists
expected_effects: Lower duplicate-effect risk across retry and resume
failure_modes: Semantic duplicates use different operation IDs
Authority expires between plan and commit
Remote effect succeeds while ledger commit fails
required_evals: duplicate-effect rate under retry and concurrency
